parsed.rationale: All five members are `type-alias-object` kinds with empty `fields_or_signature` lists, meaning the structural pipeline detected shape similarity solely on the basis of being empty-bodied type aliases — not on shared underlying types or semantics. The aliases serve distinct domain roles: `Discogs.Release.Label`, `Discogs.Release.ReleaseArtist`, and `Discogs.Master.ReleaseArtist` are nested Discogs API response model aliases in `Shared/Artwork/Sources/Artwork/DiscogsArtworkService.swift`, while `Release` and `Artist` in `Shared/Metadata/Sources/Metadata/_Plant_ReleaseRepository.swift` and `_Plant_ArtistRepository.swift` are local convenience aliases for Metadata domain types. The `_Plant_` prefix on the Metadata files further suggests these are scaffolding/plant-generated stubs, making consolidation with the Artwork aliases inappropriate. No shared semantic contract exists across these aliases that would justify extraction or unification.
